methodologyNotes: Covers standalone artist and hobby airbrush handpieces (the brush itself) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes air compressors, propellant, HVLP and automotive spray guns, and cosmetic/tanning systems sold only as bundled kits. Price is typical US MSRP/street price for the bare handpiece in USD. nozzleDiameterMm is the factory-installed nozzle/needle bore in millimetres. actionType is an enum: 'single-action' (trigger controls air only) or 'dual-action' (trigger controls air and paint independently). feedType is an enum: 'gravity' (top cup), 'siphon' (bottom bottle), or 'side' (side-mounted cup). mixType is an enum: 'internal' (paint atomised inside the head) or 'external' (paint atomised outside the tip). cupCapacityMl is the integrated fluid cup capacity in millilitres; null when the model is siphon-fed from an external bottle rather than a fixed cup. recommendedPsiRange is the manufacturer's recommended operating air pressure in PSI, written as 'min-max'. airInletThreadIn is the air-hose inlet thread size in inches, written as a fraction (e.g. '1/8'). needleNozzleInterchangeable is a boolean: true when the maker sells alternate needle/nozzle sizes that fit the same body. includedNozzleSets is the count of complete needle/nozzle sets shipped in the box. weightGrams is the bare handpiece weight without hose, in grams.

products.name: Iwata Eclipse HP-CS
products.priceNote: AMain Hobbies product page (SKU IWAECL4500) states verbatim "Price: $174.00" for the bare HP-CS handpiece; used as typical US street price. Official Iwata MSRP (~$198) could not be captured because the manufacturer site (iwata-airbrush.com) returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher.
products.provenance: The manufacturer's own site (iwata-airbrush.com) returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher, so the primary source is the AMain Hobbies page for SKU IWAECL4500, which reproduces Iwata's official spec block verbatim — "Nozzle: 0.35-mm Drop-In Self-Centering Nozzle", "Trigger Action: Dual-Action", "Paint Reservoir: 1/3 oz. (9 ml) Gravity-Feed Cup" — and lists "Price: $174.00". SprayGunner corroborates the exact model (Iwata Eclipse HP-CS, gravity feed, dual action, 0.35 mm needle/nozzle setup) and, together with AMain's note that a .5 mm needle/nozzle fits the same body, supports needleNozzleInterchangeable=true. Both pages confirm this is the 1/3 oz gravity-cup HP-CS (ECL4500), not the smaller-cup HP-BS or a siphon-fed variant; mix type, a definitive recommended PSI range, inlet thread size, included nozzle-set count and bare weight were not stated verbatim on either fetched page and are left null.

products.name: Iwata Custom Micron CM-C Plus
products.priceNote: US list price $714.25 taken verbatim from the Anest Iwata-Medea official product page for ICM4502 (archived snapshot, 2024-03-02): "$714.25". Retailer street prices render lower and in non-USD on the fetched pages (SprayGunner €496,95 EUR; HiroBoy £413.99 GBP), so the manufacturer's own listed USD figure was used rather than a converted estimate.
products.provenance: The Anest Iwata-Medea official product page (SKU ICM4502, archived 2024-03-02) confirms this exact model — Custom Micron CM-C Plus, Feed Style Gravity, Action Dual — and lists verbatim a US price of $714.25, Optimal Working Pressure "12 - 15 psi", and Paint Capacity "0.24 oz (7 ml)". The live manufacturer URL returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher, so the stable Wayback snapshot of that same manufacturer page is cited as the source. HiroBoy's exact-model listing (part IW-CM-C2-PLUS) corroborates identity and adds the "0.23mm needle and nozzle" and "Internal-mix" specs that the manufacturer spec table omits; the only weights shown on either page (Net Weight 0.88 kg / 1.93 lbs) are packaged weights including the aluminium case and accessories, so bare-handpiece weight was left null.

products.name: Paasche Talon TG-3F
products.priceNote: US regular (list) price $183.00 for the Paasche Talon TG-3F set (TG airbrush + 3 nozzle sizes + fan cap), per airbrushinfo.net's Talon-series listing: "Paasche Talon TG-3F Set w/ 3 Nozzle Sizes and Fan Cap — Regular price: $183.00" (sale price listed there was $109.80; the regular/MSRP figure is used). This reflects the TG-3F set SKU, not a bare handpiece.
products.provenance: airbrushinfo.net's Paasche Talon-series page explicitly lists the exact SKU "Paasche Talon TG-3F Set w/ 3 Nozzle Sizes and Fan Cap" at a regular price of $183.00 (sale $109.80), confirming both the model identity and the price, plus the installed .38mm fluid tip and .4 oz cup. dixieart.com's "Talon TG Series" specification table supplied the verbatim handpiece specs shared by this set: gravity feed, dual action, a built-in 0.4 oz (11.8 ml) cup, 20-75 psi optimal working pressure, and interchangeable Size 0-4 heads that install on the TG body. Paasche's own current site has retired the "TG-3F" SKU name (the 3-head-plus-fan set is now catalogued as TG-3AS), so no live manufacturer page carries the exact "TG-3F" designation; mixType, air-inlet thread (shown only as a "¼-20" HTML entity), and a bare-handpiece gram weight were left null because none appear verbatim for this exact model.

products.name: Grex Tritium.TG3
products.priceNote: Sprue Brothers Models (US retailer, Liberty MO) lists this exact model (SKU GRXTG3) at MSRP $329.00 verbatim, with their sale/our-price at $218.00. Used the labeled MSRP $329.00 as priceUsd. The manufacturer page shows no price.
products.provenance: The Grex USA manufacturer page for the Tritium.TG confirmed the body specs verbatim: "Double Action Pistol Style" (dual-action), "Top Gravity" feed, "Internally mixed media" (internal mix), "Weight: 180g", "Oper. Pressure: 5 ~ 80psi", and optional nozzle conversion kits (TK-2/3/5/7) that fit the same body (needle/nozzle interchangeable). Model identity as the 0.3mm TG3 variant was confirmed on the Sprue Brothers US retailer page (SKU GRXTG3, title "Grex Tritium TG3 ... (0.3mm Nozzle) #TG3", "Fluid Nozzle: 0.3mm"), which independently repeats the same 180g weight and 5~80psi range and lists MSRP $329.00 (sale $218.00). One retailer (Midwest Airbrush) listed 14~80psi, but both the manufacturer and Sprue Brothers state 5~80psi, so that figure was used; the built-in cup has no stated numeric capacity (ships with separate 2/7/15mL reservoirs) and no air-inlet thread size is published, so both were left null.

products.name: Sparmax MAX-3
products.priceNote: Manufacturer's official product page (sparmaxair.com/airbrush-0-3-1/max-3) lists "Suggested Price: US$88" for the bare MAX-3 handpiece; used as US MSRP.
products.provenance: The official Sparmax product page (sparmaxair.com) confirms this exact model "MAX-3" as the newer 0.3 mm / 7 cc version of the DH-3 and lists its "Suggested Price: US$88", the source for priceUsd. The SprayGunner US retailer listing corroborates the identical MAX-3 handpiece — "0.3mm needle & nozzle", "Gravity feed with 1/4 oz (7ml) fixed cup", "Internal mix design", and "dual-action" convertible to single-action — confirming nozzle bore, cup capacity, feedType, mixType, actionType and one included 0.3mm needle/nozzle set. No fetched page stated a numeric operating-PSI range, air-inlet thread size, or bare handpiece weight, so those keys are left null.

products.name: GSI Creos Mr. Procon Boy WA Platinum
products.priceNote: US retailer A-Z Toy Hobby (Katy, TX) lists the "Mr. Hobby PS289 Mr. Procon Boy WA Platinum 0.3mm Airbrush" at $123.95 USD (SKU PS289, barcode 4973028835014). SprayGunner's listing for the same PS-289 was in EUR (€93.95-€120.95), so it was not used for the USD figure.
products.provenance: The GSI Creos manufacturer page (mr-hobby.com) confirms the exact model identity as "PROCON BOY WA PLATINUM Ver.2 0.3mm", Product Number PS289 — the WA Platinum 0.3mm handpiece, distinct from the 0.2mm FWA (PS-270) and 0.5mm LWA (PS-266) siblings. US retailer A-Z Toy Hobby corroborates the same model (SKU PS289, barcode 4973028835014) and supplies the verbatim specs — 0.3mm screw-in nozzle, double action, gravity feed, 10cc cup, 1/8 BSP air connection, and PS-270/PS-289 interchangeable needle/nozzle — plus the price of $123.95 USD. SprayGunner independently confirms it as the "Procon Boy WA Platinum Double Action 0.3mm ... PS-289" made in Japan, reinforcing the identity match.
